summary: Lane 41 (Cryptography) on shop.lab.test. Results: CRYP-01 done: HTTP answers, HTTPS on 443 refused, port 8443 gave a non-TLS response, no HSTS or redirect, so there is no TLS configuration to assess and credentials and cookies go over plain HTTP. CRYP-02 N/A: no CBC-encrypted token observed; the invoice ref is plain base64 and the statement token is redacted and unneeded. CRYP-03 done: sign-in form posts over http, session cookie lacks Secure and is cached as public, and the statement link carries a session token in the URL. CRYP-04 done: invoice ref is base64 encoding of plaintext, tamper gave a generic 404, and the source map has only stub sourcesContent; secrets in app.js were left to the secrets lane. Caveats: the HTTPS refusals returned no exchange IDs, so they are cited only in the summaries. I did not send GET /account/password or any other state-changing request; the reviewer should still check alice's password as the sess lane flagged. Also, the gateway sets the research headers itself, so I did not add my own. Writes were not used.
